headline: Chile Rancher Appeals $11 Billion HNH Energy Hydrogen Project Permit
summary: A Patagonian rancher has launched appeals asking Chilean government ministers to overturn the environmental permit granted in August for HNH Energy's $11 billion green hydrogen and ammonia project.
why: Chile is aiming to become a premier global producer and exporter of green hydrogen, but multi-billion dollar megaprojects face environmental and local regulatory legal hurdles.

impacts.name: HNH Energy
impacts.why: Ministerial appeals introduce legal uncertainty and potential delays to the $11B project.
